Name: The Carbonizer
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
The Carbonizer is an upgraded charcoal kiln designed to compress those items you hoard but never use (like Sap, Fiber, and Driftwood) into Coal. Let's make those hoarding tendencies work for you.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332435.png[/img]

[list]
[*]A New custom machine added for your coal making preferences that turn commonly hoarded items into coal:
[*]Machine is unlocked at Mining level 6
[*]New coal recipes:
[*]5 Fiber- 1 Coal - 40m
[*]10 Sap - 1 - 3 Coal - 30m
[*]1 Driftwood - 2 - 4 Coal - 60m
[*]1 Hardwood - 5 - 7 Coal - 120m﻿
[*]5 Wood - 2 - 4 Coal  - 30m (added v1.1)
[*]1 Torch - 1 - 3 Coal - 20m (added v1.1)
[*]1 Trash - 1 - 2 Coal - 30m (added v1.1)
[*]1 Newspaper - 1-2 Coal - 30m (added v1.1)
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332579.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE) and most other major content mods.
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332629.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].﻿
[*]Unzip this mod's folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332703.png[/img]

[list]
